hybrid_3k_epoch_matched.note: Follow-up run capped at 3000 epochs to capture the pre-overfit sweet spot identified in docs/15 SS11 (pendulum_full monitor loss argmin was epoch 2950, value 0.0542) -- pendulum_full itself only saved a min_train_mse checkpoint from deep in the overfit region, so this is a fresh run with the SAME recipe (lr=0.003, grid_len=8, blend_lr_mult=15) to get an actual saved checkpoint near that point.
